runtime.description: Loaded directly by index.html and part of the production browser application.

ci_generator.description: Not browser-loaded; executed by validation/reproducibility tooling and treated as source-of-truth model logic.

rules: Every src/*.js file must be classified exactly once.
Only runtime and CI-generator source roles are allowed; dormant/offline source modules belong outside src or must be deleted.
The runtime file set must exactly match script files loaded by index.html.
CI-generator modules must not be loaded by index.html and must have validation or derivation-manifest references.
Adding a source module without a runtime or CI execution role fails CI.
Deleting or renaming a classified module without updating this inventory fails CI.
